business_objective: Measurement, tracking, experimentation, and channel governance for 65W GaN charger launch in Vietnam.

metric_taxonomy.attention: 3-Second Hook Retention Rate (3s views / total impressions)
metric_taxonomy.economics: Cost Per Initiated Checkout (spend / checkouts, TO_BE_ESTABLISHED)

deferred_channels.rationale: Current evidence is strongly tech-commuter oriented and does not establish broad non-technical mass market fit.

performance_hypotheses: HYP-01: VAR-A OEM Brick Friction hook achieves higher 3s hook retention than VAR-B 2-in-1 Feature hook.
HYP-02: Upfront device compatibility checking tool increases landing-to-checkout initiation rate.

experiment_portfolio.name: Creative Hook Mechanism Test (VAR-A vs VAR-B)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, and variance derivation)

experiment_portfolio.name: Compatibility CTA vs Direct Buy Test (VAR-C vs Standard)
Ecommerce Search Keyword Intent Test ('sac gan 65w')

risks: High ad-blocker usage suppressing client-side pixel events in tech audiences.
Thermal anxiety causing high product page abandonment if heat dissipation specs are unclear.

decision_rules.action: CONTINUE VAR-A as primary creative anchor

decision_rules.condition: Sample size inadequate or 95% CI spans zero
decision_rules.action: Declare outcome INCONCLUSIVE; continue test until sample reached

escalations: Escalate to CMO: Business budget authorization required for paid search testing (PEXP-003).

candidate_learnings.hypothesis: Commuter bag-weight friction hooks generate higher attention than feature-only charging hooks for compatible USB-C laptop audiences.

evidence_lineage.EVID-GAN65-01..05: Verified GaN hardware parameters and user pain points
